1206d0e1d0.subject: adsets-all-spend-gap
1206d0e1d0.title: adsets-all under-sums spend -$82.07 (-4.6%) vs KPI; Neon adset spend is complete
1206d0e1d0.unblocking_action: RESOLVED AS BY-DESIGN 2026-09-28. Root cause was an objective filter, not orphan Whop ad sets: adsets-all omits non-lead-gen campaigns and their spend still counts in the KPI, so the drill-down is SUPPOSED to sum lower. Orbit PR #587 widens that exclusion from name-only to name-OR-awareness-objective, which makes the gap LARGER and fully intentional. Andy's side is fixed in checks/registry.json: F1/F2/F3 now carry the excluded_campaigns rule and must subtract excluded spend before comparing. VERIFY after #587 deploys: the gap should equal excluded-campaign spend exactly, and F1 should stop firing.
1206d0e1d0.note: insights adset==campaign 1802.28; endpoint 1720.21. Whop ad groups may not map to Meta adsets
